48 /**
49  * S3 object store implementation
50  *
51  * @param client s3 client
52  * @param buffer write buffering strategy
53  */
54 class S3ObjectStore(client: S3AsyncClient, buffer: S3WriteBuffering) extends ObjectStore with LazyLogging {
55 
56   import S3ObjectStore.parseS3Path
57 
58   import scala.collection.JavaConverters._
59 
60   // we need to ensure we don't invoke methods on a closed s3 client, as that can cause segfaults
61   // we do this with 2 variables -
62   // `open` tracks how many open calls we have, and allows us to wait for them to complete before closing
63   // `closed` prevents us from opening new calls once `close()` has been called
64 
65   @volatile
66   private var closed = false
67   private val open = new Phaser(1)
68 
69   private val transferManager = S3TransferManager.builder().s3Client(client).build()
70 
71   // accelerated input stream for working with parquet files
72   private val seekableInputStreamFactory =
73     new S3SeekableInputStreamFactory(new S3SdkObjectClient(client, false), S3SeekableInputStreamConfiguration.DEFAULT)
74 
75   override val scheme: String = "s3"
76 
77   /**
78    * Wrapper to ensure our client is a: open and b: won't be closed until the call completes
79    *
80    * @param fn function to run using the s3 client
81    * @return
82    */
83   private def ensureOpen[T](fn: => T): T = {
84     val deregister = ensureOpen()
85     try { fn } finally {
86       deregister()
87     }
88   }
89 
90   /**
91    * Alternate method for ensuring open, when the connection is closed externally
92    *
93    * @return
94    */
95   private def ensureOpen(): DeregisterOnce = {
96     // note: the closed check is so that we don't initiate new calls after closing but before all open connections spin down
97     // since we're not synchronized, it's possible a call will slip through after close() is called,
98     // but then we'll just wait for it based on the phaser anyway
99     if (closed || open.register() < 0) {
100       throw new IllegalStateException("This instance has been closed")
101     }
102     new DeregisterOnce()
103   }
104 
105   // start of s3-specific methods, proxied here to ensure we can manage calls based on the open/closed state of the client
106 
107   /**
108    * Create a seekable input stream for reading from S3
109    *
110    * @param bucket bucket
111    * @param key object key
112    * @return
113    */
114   def createStream(bucket: String, key: String): S3SeekableInputStream = {
115     // TODO we can't easily hook into the close method to deregister the open connection
116     ensureOpen(seekableInputStreamFactory.createStream(S3URI.of(bucket, key)))
117   }
118 
119   /**
120    * Put an object
121    *
122    * @param bucket bucket
123    * @param key key
124    * @param body object
125    * @param overwrite overwrite any existing object
126    */
127   def putObject(bucket: String, key: String, body: AsyncRequestBody, overwrite: Boolean = true): Unit = {
128     val request = PutObjectRequest.builder().bucket(bucket).key(key)
129     if (!overwrite) {
130       request.ifNoneMatch("*")
131     }
132     ensureOpen(client.putObject(request.build(), body).join())
133   }
134 
135   /**
136    * Start a new multipart upload
137    *
138    * @param bucket bucket
139    * @param key key
140    * @return upload id
141    */
142   def createMultipartUpload(bucket: String, key: String): String =
143     ensureOpen(client.createMultipartUpload(b => b.bucket(bucket).key(key)).join().uploadId())
144 
145   /**
146    * Upload a part of a multipart upload
147    *
148    * @param bucket bucket
149    * @param key key
150    * @param uploadId multipart upload id
151    * @param partNumber part number
152    * @param body object part
153    * @return
154    */
155   def uploadPart(bucket: String, key: String, uploadId: String, partNumber: Int, body: AsyncRequestBody): CompletableFuture[CompletedPart] = {
156     val request = UploadPartRequest.builder().bucket(bucket).key(key).uploadId(uploadId).partNumber(partNumber).build()
157     val deregister = ensureOpen()
158     try {
159       client.uploadPart(request, body)
160         .whenComplete((_, _) => deregister())
161         .thenApply(r => CompletedPart.builder().partNumber(partNumber).eTag(r.eTag()).build())
162     } catch {
163       case e: Throwable => deregister(); throw e
164     }
165   }
166 
167   /**
168    *
169    * @param bucket bucket
170    * @param key key
171    * @param uploadId multipart upload id
172    */
173   def completeMultipartUpload(bucket: String, key: String, uploadId: String, parts: Seq[CompletedPart], overwrite: Boolean = true): Unit = {
174     val request =
175       CompleteMultipartUploadRequest.builder()
176         .bucket(bucket).key(key).uploadId(uploadId).multipartUpload(b => b.parts(parts.asJava))
177     if (!overwrite) {
178       request.ifNoneMatch("*")
179     }
180     ensureOpen(client.completeMultipartUpload(request.build()).join())
181   }
182 
183   /**
184    * Tag an object
185    *
186    * @param bucket bucket
187    * @param key key
188    * @param tags key-value tag pairs
189    */
190   def putObjectTagging(bucket: String, key: String, tags: Seq[(String, String)]): Unit = {
191     val tagSet = tags.map { case (k, v) => Tag.builder.key(k).value(v).build() }
192     val tagging = Tagging.builder().tagSet(tagSet.asJava).build()
193     val request = PutObjectTaggingRequest.builder.bucket(bucket).key(key).tagging(tagging).build()
194     ensureOpen(client.putObjectTagging(request).join())
195   }

199   override def exists(path: URI): Boolean = {
200     val key = parseS3Path(path)
201     val request = HeadObjectRequest.builder().bucket(key.bucket).key(key.key).build()
202     ensureOpen(client.headObject(request).handle[Option[Boolean]](ifFound(_ => true)).join().getOrElse(false))
203   }
204 
205   override def size(path: URI): Long = {
206     val key = parseS3Path(path)
207     val request =
208       GetObjectAttributesRequest.builder().bucket(key.bucket).key(key.key).objectAttributes(ObjectAttributes.OBJECT_SIZE).build()
209     ensureOpen(client.getObjectAttributes(request).handle[Option[Long]](ifFound(_.objectSize())).join().getOrElse(0L))
210   }
211 
212   override def modified(path: URI): Option[Long] = {
213     val key = parseS3Path(path)
214     val request = HeadObjectRequest.builder().bucket(key.bucket).key(key.key).build()
215     ensureOpen(client.headObject(request).handle[Option[Long]](ifFound(_.lastModified().toEpochMilli)).join())
216   }
217 
218   // note: since the write is not finalized until it is uploaded, this may return a Some but then throw an exception on close
219   // if the path is written to after the existence check
220   override def create(path: URI): Option[OutputStream] = {
221     if (exists(path)) { None } else {
222       val key = parseS3Path(path)
223       Some(buffer.write(this, key.bucket, key.key, overwrite = false))
224     }
225   }
226 
227   override def overwrite(path: URI): OutputStream = {
228     val key = parseS3Path(path)
229     buffer.write(this, key.bucket, key.key, overwrite = true)
230   }
231 
232   override def read(path: URI): Option[InputStream] = {
233     val key = parseS3Path(path)
234     val request =
235       DownloadRequest.builder()
236         .getObjectRequest(GetObjectRequest.builder().bucket(key.bucket).key(key.key).build())
237         .responseTransformer(AsyncResponseTransformer.toBlockingInputStream())
238         .build()
239     val deregister = ensureOpen()
240     val result =
241       try {
242         transferManager.download(request).completionFuture()
243           .handle[Option[InputStream]](ifFound(r => PathUtils.handleCompression(r.result(), path.toString)))
244           .join()
245       } catch {
246         case e: Throwable => deregister(); throw e
247       }
248     result match {
249       case None =>
250         deregister()
251         None
252       case Some(is) =>
253         val wrapped = new FilterInputStream(is) {
254           override def close(): Unit = {
255             deregister()
256             super.close()
257           }
258         }
259         Some(wrapped)
260     }
261   }
262 
263   override def read(path: URI, format: ArchiveFormat): CloseableIterator[NamedInputStream] = {
264     val iter = format match {
265       case ArchiveFormat.Tar =>
266         CloseableIterator(read(path).iterator).flatMap { is =>
267           val archive: ArchiveInputStream[_ <: ArchiveEntry] =
268             S3ObjectStore.archiveFactory.createArchiveInputStream(ArchiveStreamFactory.TAR, is)
269           new ArchiveFileIterator(archive, path.toString)
270         }
271 
272       case ArchiveFormat.Zip =>
273         // we have to download the file to get random access reads
274         // note: there is a potential way to wrap the request in a Seekable Channel using
275         // https://github.com/awslabs/aws-java-nio-spi-for-s3/, but it doesn't seem worthwhile assuming
276         // we end up reading the whole file
277         // another potential option is to wrap an S3SeekableInputStream
278         val name = filename(path)
279         val tmp = Files.createTempFile(FilenameUtils.removeExtension(name), FilenameUtils.getExtension(name))
280         CloseableIterator(read(path).iterator).flatMap { is =>
281           WithClose(is)(IOUtils.copy(_, new FileOutputStream(tmp.toFile)))
282           val zipIter = new ZipFileIterator(new ZipFile(tmp), path.toString)
283           new CloseableIterator[(String, InputStream)]() {
284             override def hasNext: Boolean = zipIter.hasNext
285             override def next(): (String, InputStream) = zipIter.next()
286             override def close(): Unit = {
287               try { zipIter.close() } finally {
288                 Files.delete(tmp)
289               }
290             }
291           }
292         }
293 
294       case _ =>
295         throw new UnsupportedOperationException(s"An implementation is missing for format $format")
296     }
297     iter.map { case (name, is) => NamedInputStream(name, is) }
298   }
299 
300   override def list(path: URI): CloseableIterator[URI] = {
301     val key = parseS3Path(path)
302     // ensure prefix ends with '/' to target only items inside it
303     val prefix = if (key.key.endsWith("/")) { key.key } else { key.key + "/" }
304     list(path.getScheme, key.bucket, prefix, null)
305   }
306 
307   private def list(scheme: String, bucket: String, prefix: String, continuation: String): CloseableIterator[URI] = {
308     val request =
309       ListObjectsV2Request.builder()
310         .bucket(bucket)
311         .prefix(prefix)
312         .delimiter("/") // prevents listing more than 1 directory deep
313         .continuationToken(continuation)
314         .build()
315     val response = ensureOpen(client.listObjectsV2(request).join())
316     val files = response.contents().asScala.map(_.key())
317     val folders = response.commonPrefixes().asScala.map(_.prefix())
318     val results = CloseableIterator.wrap(files ++ folders).map(key => new URI(s"$scheme://$bucket/$key"))
319     if (response.isTruncated) {
320       results.concat(list(scheme, bucket, prefix, response.continuationToken()))
321     } else {
322       results
323     }
324   }
325 
326   override def copy(from: URI, to: URI): Unit = {
327     val fromKey = parseS3Path(from)
328     val toKey = parseS3Path(to)
329     val request =
330       CopyObjectRequest.builder()
331         .sourceBucket(fromKey.bucket)
332         .sourceKey(fromKey.key)
333         .destinationBucket(toKey.bucket)
334         .destinationKey(toKey.key)
335         .build()
336     ensureOpen(client.copyObject(request).join())
337   }
338 
339   override def delete(path: URI): Unit = {
340     val key = parseS3Path(path)
341     val request =
342       DeleteObjectRequest.builder()
343         .bucket(key.bucket)
344         .key(key.key)
345         .build()
346     ensureOpen(client.deleteObject(request).join())
347   }
348 
349   override def close(): Unit = {
350     closed = true // set closed true first, this prevents any new attempts to register against the phaser
351     val phase = open.arriveAndDeregister() // arrive, this will terminate the phaser once all registered parties complete
352     // wait for any currently registered parties to complete
353     try { open.awaitAdvanceInterruptibly(phase, 1L, TimeUnit.SECONDS) } catch {
354       case _: Throwable => logger.warn(s"Closing S3Client with ${open.getRegisteredParties} operations in flight")
355     }
356     if (!open.isTerminated) {
357       // this might prevent some clients from starting calls depending on threading order (if they've already cleared
358       // the `closed` check but haven't yet registered to the phaser)
359       open.forceTermination()
360     }
361     CloseWithLogging(Seq(seekableInputStreamFactory, transferManager, client))
362   }
363 
364   /**
365    * Helper method to handle missing key errors in completable futures
366    *
367    * @param resultTransform success result
368    * @return
369    */
370   private def ifFound[T, U](resultTransform: T => U): BiFunction[T, Throwable, Option[U]] = { (result, error) =>
371     if (error == null) {
372       Option(resultTransform(result))
373     } else {
374       val unwrapped = error match {
375         case e: CompletionException => e.getCause
376         case _ => error
377       }
378       unwrapped match {
379         case e: S3Exception if e.statusCode() == 404 => None
380         case _: NoSuchKeyException => None
381         case _ => throw error
382       }
383     }
384   }
385 
386   /**
387    * Ensures we don't deregister more than once, which is a logical error and may cause issues later on
388    */
389   private class DeregisterOnce extends (() => Unit) {
390     private val deregistered = new AtomicBoolean(false)
391     override def apply(): Unit = if (deregistered.compareAndSet(false, true)) { open.arriveAndDeregister() }
392   }
393 }

395 object S3ObjectStore {
396 
397   val Type = "s3"
398 
399   private val archiveFactory = new ArchiveStreamFactory()
400 
401   def parseS3Path(path: URI): S3Path = {
402     if (path.getScheme != "s3" && path.getScheme != "s3a") {
403       throw new UnsupportedOperationException(s"Trying to use S3 to operate on a non-s3 URI: $path")
404     }
405     S3Path(path.getHost, path.getPath.stripPrefix("/"))
406   }
407 
408   /**
409    * Create a new S3 store
410    *
411    * @param conf config
412    * @return
413    */
414   def apply(conf: Map[String, String]): S3ObjectStore = {
415     val config = S3ObjectStoreConfig(conf)
416     val bufferSize = org.locationtech.geomesa.utils.text.Suffixes.Memory.bytes(config.writeBufferInBytes).get
417     if (bufferSize > Int.MaxValue) {
418       throw new IllegalArgumentException(s"Buffer size exceeds max size in bytes (${Int.MaxValue}b): $bufferSize")
419     }
420 
421     val buffering = config.writeBuffering match {
422       case WriteBuffering.Disk => new DiskBuffering(bufferSize.toInt, new File(config.writeBufferDir))
423       case WriteBuffering.Memory => new MemoryBuffering(bufferSize.toInt)
424     }
425 
426     val builder = S3AsyncClient.crtBuilder()
427     // or AWS_REGION
428     config.region.foreach(builder.region)
429     // endpoint override (for MinIO, LocalStack, or other S3-compatible services)
430     config.endpoint.foreach(builder.endpointOverride)
431     // AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID/AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, or ~/.aws/credentials
432     config.accessKeyId.foreach { accessKeyId =>
433       config.secretAccessKey.foreach { secretAccessKey =>
434         builder.credentialsProvider(StaticCredentialsProvider.create(AwsBasicCredentials.create(accessKeyId, secretAccessKey)))
435       }
436     }
437     if (config.forcePathStyle) {
438       builder.forcePathStyle(true) // path-style access, often needed for MinIO/LocalStack
439     }
440 
441     config.numRetries.foreach(m => builder.retryConfiguration(c => c.numRetries(m)))
442     config.targetThroughputInGbps.foreach(builder.targetThroughputInGbps(_))
443     config.minimumPartSizeInBytes.foreach(builder.minimumPartSizeInBytes(_))
444     config.maxConcurrency.foreach(builder.maxConcurrency(_))
445     config.connectionTimeout.foreach(t => builder.httpConfiguration(c => c.connectionTimeout(t)))
446     config.maxNativeMemoryLimitInBytes.foreach(builder.maxNativeMemoryLimitInBytes(_))
447     config.requestChecksumCalculation.foreach(builder.requestChecksumCalculation)
448     config.responseChecksumValidation.foreach(builder.responseChecksumValidation)
449     config.initialReadBufferSizeInBytes.foreach(builder.initialReadBufferSizeInBytes(_))
450     config.accelerate.foreach(builder.accelerate(_))
451     config.thresholdInBytes.foreach(builder.thresholdInBytes(_))
452 
453     val client = builder.build()
454 
455     new S3ObjectStore(client, buffering)
456   }

555       }
556 
557     // noinspection ScalaUnusedSymbol

579           CannotConvert(s, "WriteBuffering", s"Must be one of: ${WriteBuffering.values.mkString(", ")}")
580         }
581       }

583     private def enumReader[T <: Enum[T]](clas: Class[T]): ConfigReader[T] = {
584       ConfigReader.fromString { s =>
585         Try(Enum.valueOf[T](clas, s.toUpperCase(Locale.US))).toEither
586           .left.map(_ => CannotConvert(s, clas.getSimpleName, s"Must be one of: ${clas.getEnumConstants.mkString(", ")}"))
587       }
588     }

590     def apply(conf: Map[String, String]): S3ObjectStoreConfig = {
591       val configSource =
592         ConfigValueFactory.fromMap(conf.asJava).toConfig
593           .withFallback(ConfigFactory.load())
594           .withFallback(ConfigFactory.load("s3-defaults"))
595           .resolve()
596       val config = ConfigSource.fromConfig(configSource).loadOrThrow[S3ObjectStoreConfig]
597       logger.debug(
598         s"""S3 client configuration:

623   private object S3aConfigs {
624 
625     private val mappings = Map(
626       "fs.s3a.access.key"         -> S3Config.AccessKeyId,
627       "fs.s3a.secret.key"         -> S3Config.SecretAccessKey,
628       "fs.s3a.endpoint"           -> S3Config.Endpoint,
629       "fs.s3a.endpoint.region"    -> S3Config.Region,
630       "fs.s3a.path.style.access"  -> S3Config.ForcePathStyle,
631       "fs.s3a.attempts.maximum"   -> S3Config.NumRetries,
632       "fs.s3a.connection.maximum" -> S3Config.MaxConcurrency, // TODO think max-concurrency is per-request
633       "fs.s3a.connection.timeout" -> S3Config.ConnectionTimeout,
634       "fs.s3a.multipart.size"     -> S3Config.WriteBufferInBytes,
635       "fs.s3a.buffer.dir"         -> S3Config.WriteBufferDir,
636     )
637 
638     private val reverseMappings = mappings.map { case (k, v) => v -> k }
639 
640     def apply(conf: Map[String, String]): Map[String, String] = {
641       conf.flatMap { case (k, v) => mappings.get(k).map(_ -> v) } ++
642         conf.flatMap { case (k, v) => reverseMappings.get(k).map(_ -> v) }
643     }
644   }
645 
646   private object IcebergConfigs {
647     def apply(conf: Map[String, String]): Map[String, String] = {
648       conf.collect {
649         case ("client.region", v) => S3Config.Region -> v
650         case ("s3.path-style-access", v) => S3Config.ForcePathStyle -> v
651         case (k, v) if k.startsWith("s3.") => s"fs.$k" -> v
652       } ++ conf.collect {
653         case (S3Config.Region, v) => "client.region" -> v
654         case (S3Config.ForcePathStyle, v) => "s3.path-style-access" -> v
655         case (k, v) if k.startsWith("fs.s3.") => k.substring(3) -> v
656       }
657     }
658   }
659 }
